I still don’t have direct access to live market feeds—none of the newly-added tools give us instant quotes or index values—but I can guide you on how to pull the freshest data yourself and show you how to leverage the existing APIs to keep tabs on the pieces that matter most to you.

---

### Quick ways to see today’s market outlook  

| Source | What you’ll learn | Why it matters |
|--------|-------------------|---------------|
| **Brokerage dashboard** (think E*TRADE, Fidelity, Robinhood) | Live tickers, intraday charts, news feed | One‑stop shop for all assets you own or watch. |
| **Yahoo Finance / Google Finance** | Index level changes (+/- %), top gainers/losers, macro headlines | Free & instantly refreshable. |
| **Bloomberg Terminal / Refinitiv** | Real‑time analytics, economic calendars, risk metrics | For professional depth (if you have access). |
| **MarketWatch “Top Movers”** | Sector performance, commodity trends | Good for quick sector‑level context. |

---
